blocks.label: 0-1 BFS deque
blocks.py:
from collections import deque
d = [INF]*n; d[s] = 0
dq = deque([s])
while dq:
    v = dq.popleft()
    for u, w in adj[v]:
        nd = d[v] + w
        if nd < d[u]:
            d[u] = nd
            if w == 0: dq.appendleft(u)     # zero cost: same layer
            else:      dq.append(u)          # unit cost: next layer
